_comment: Per-episode config for build_edl.py. Fill refs and offsets from Phase 1 (sync), kept_M from Phases 2 and 3 (intro splice, body minus cuts). All values below are placeholders.

refs._comment: Palmier media IDs for each source (from inspect_media or the project). With another editor, use any label you can map back to a file.

offsets._comment: Each media's placement frame in the synced master (M-space). trimStart = M - offset. Mic offsets can be negative if the mics rolled before the cameras.

_kept_note: Master-frame ranges that survive: intro take A, intro take B, then the body. List each surviving sub-range of the body after removing fluff, dead air and retakes.

shot._comment: Camera-cut tuning. Check the on-cam and wide split the script prints, and override only if a guest needs a different rhythm.
shot._shot_note: min_wide_s and min_shot_s set a hard floor on every cut (no flashes). wide_every_s recurs the two-shot every N seconds inside a single-speaker run (lower means more wide).
